Rafael / Sarah — quick ops notes based on the markup: 

- Invoice flow: Redwood invoices MarketWave (platform fee) — MarketWave invoices end-customer where required. For pass-through billing we propose a single net-settlement approach: Redwood collects gross, remits partner share monthly minus agreed adjustments.
- Credits/Refunds: propose 45-day reversal window — if a refund/chargeback occurs within 45 days we adjust the next settlement. Language below can be added to Order Form: 

  "Settlement and Adjustments: Redwood will remit Partner Share within 30 days following the end of the calendar month. Any refunds, credits, or chargebacks reported within 45 days of transaction date will be deducted from the subsequent remittance. Detailed reconciliation reports will be provided quarterly."

- Audit evidence: ops can produce per-tenant usage reports, invoice line-items, and payment receipts. Need legal to confirm retention obligations (12 vs 24 months).

I'll bring a short waterfall table to the call.

Thanks all — legal summary and redline highlights below (high level):

1) Invoicing entity & tax: Need to ensure Order Form explicitly names which entity issues the invoice to end customer vs partner invoice. If MarketWave requires passthrough with tax collection, we need indemnity language for tax shortfalls.

2) Audit & evidence: Accept quarterly reconciliations and one annual audit, but carveout language for scope — audits limited to transaction-level data for the previous 24 months and subject to 30-day notice. Any production-impacting requests must be scoped separately.

3) Liability allocation: Limit Redwood liability tied to pass-through errors to net revenue incorrectly remitted; do not accept open-ended audit-based indemnity.

4) Data retention: Recommend 24 months for reconciliation evidence; ops to confirm feasibility.

I attached a short legal snippet (pasted below) you can drop into the MSA: 

  "Pass-Through Transactions: Where Transactions are transacted via a Marketplace listing, the parties agree that Redwood will act as merchant of record for billing purposes unless otherwise specified in the Order Form. Settlement mechanics, refund handling, and Partner Share timing shall be governed by the Order Form. Partners may request reconciliations on a quarterly basis and one audit per 12-month period, subject to the Audit Scope limitations described herein."

Let's confirm the DocuSign envelope once Ben & Laura sign off on the waterfall language. Rafael — happy to review the final combined redline before you send to MarketWave Legal.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
